messages:
Alan: Quick sync — we need to finalize the cross-org retention + certification playbook for enterprise customers this quarter. Main asks: per-tenant retention windows, BYOK/KMS handshake, audit-log export SLA, evidence packaging format. Who can own launch criteria?
Priya: I can own launch criteria. Need Security + Legal sign-off. Proposed must-haves: per-tenant retention rules exposed in Console, exportable audit evidence, immutable audit logs, BYOK lifecycle docs, and rollout playbook.
Kevin: +1. Important to call out key rotation/escrow and attestation steps for SOC2/ISO. Customers asking for 72h evidence export; ops/eng feasibility? If not, fall back to 7 days in contract.
Marta: Legal note — contract language prefers 7d for standard delivery but ok to commit to 72h for "expedited" or enterprise tiers. Need explicit retention visibility and opt-out/right-to-ask clauses.
Li: Engineering reality check: our export pipeline is async and currently designed for <1TB. For tenants >10TB, 72h is hard. Options: (1) default SLA 7d, (2) expedited paid export (streaming), (3) retention tiers with precomputed indexes. Per-tenant retention toggles require metadata + background cleaner work (~2 sprints).
Jean: Ops data point — storage costs scale nonlinearly with retention; offering 10y for enterprise will need archival cold tier + retrieval jobs. We should define retention buckets now to unblock design.
Priya: Drafting suggested retention buckets:
```
retention_buckets:
  ephemeral: 30d
  default: 365d
  enterprise: 3650d  # ~10 years
```
Priya: Launch criteria proposal (short):
- Per-tenant retention config in Console (read + write)
- Export pipeline: ability to export audit evidence (logs + attachments) within 72h for <=1TB, 7d otherwise
- BYOK handshake doc + test harness for key rotation and escrow
- Immutable audit logging with checksum & tamper flags
- Playbook for SOC2/ISO evidence packaging and attestation
- Security + Legal sign-off in docs
Kevin: Technical owners: Security owns BYOK attestation doc and threat model. Eng owns export pipeline SLA and retention enforcement. Ops owns archival retrieval runbooks.
Li: I'll estimate effort tomorrow but rough: retention toggles + cleaner = 2 sprints; export streaming prototype = 3 sprints; archival cold tier + retrieval = 2 sprints. Canary plan: prototype -> 3 pilot customers -> iterate.
Marta: Legal will draft contract addendum for retention tiers and expedited export SLA. Also prepare standard wording for evidence requests and data subject clauses.
ops-bot: RFC created: https://rwd.internal/r/CR-4521 — "Cross-org retention & certification playbook". JIRA EPIC: RWD-9812.
Priya: Rollout plan idea: week 0 design + security review, week 2 prototype, week 6 canary w/ 3 customers (one large, one mid, one small), monitor export latency, success rate, and disk/backfill load.
Jean: Monitoring KPIs: export latency P50/P95, export success rate, background cleaner CPU/IO, archival retrieval time. Alert thresholds: export error rate >1% or P95 >24h for expedited group.
Alan: Decision summary so far: keep default SLA = 7d, offer expedited 72h for <=1TB (paid/enterprise), retention buckets as above, BYOK + escrow required for enterprise onboarding, and require legal + security sign-off. Can we lock owners?
Priya: Owners: Priya (launch criteria + PM), Li (eng lead), Kevin (security lead), Marta (legal), Jean (ops lead). I'll create the EPIC + owners now.
Li: I'll post a scoping doc tomorrow with estimates. Can we add a dependency on a small infra ticket to surface per-tenant metadata?
Kevin: I'll start the BYOK attestation draft and share threat model next week.
Marta: I'll draft contract language and share redlines in this thread.
Alan: Great — locking this as a priority for next sprint. Please add blockers as they come. :thumbsup:
Priya: Added EPIC RWD-9812 and linked RFC. Leaving a checklist in the EPIC.
Jean: I'll schedule the canary customer outreach after Li posts estimates.
ops-bot: Reminder: add SOC2 evidence checklist to the playbook doc (section: evidence-packaging).
Alan: Thanks everyone — follow-ups in the EPIC.
